decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program costs little to keep, sits within the firm's publicly stated promise of fast response, and has stayed on the website through 2024, so dropping it would undercut the visible delivery commitment without freeing much.

The seventy-two-hour program is still mentioned and is part of the firm's announced speed promise, and any logistics strain it causes can be blamed on temporary capacity issues rather than counted as a failure.
As a multi-model express line with its own dedicated page in both years, it carries substantial visible investment and public commitment, so management would persist with it.

The online ordering and digital services platform is a major sunk investment that is central to the announced direction of deeper service support, and it is prominently presented, so writing it off would be very unlikely.

The fire and smoke protection door was promoted to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment and certification investment, and it stands as the surviving fire-protection offer after Product C was withdrawn.
